Hi Hayden, I was born a 31 weeks more than 40 years ago and there was zero talk about abortion once I was past the stage of viability. In fact, now, the week viability is even 23-25 weeks. And that is providing that there are no severe medical complications. There are situations that I’ve had this happen to friends who’ve lost their babies in utero in the late stages of pregnancy, but that’s still not abortion. We live in a country without universal healthcare, very little social safety, nets, including disability, so please let families make the decision for what’s best for them.
